data-intake: transfer-interface-limits datatype + PJM measured interface-limit overlay

New clean datatype (schema-first, per-ISO registry, PJM Data Miner 2
transfer_limits_and_flows 2023-2025 onto the model clock) and the gated
backcast overlay ScenarioConfig.pjm_measured_interface_limits: mapped
internal links' forward TTC follows the measured hourly published series
(min of pre/post-contingency), reverse/unmapped keep the Tier-3 statics.
Crosswalk misalignments documented per rule 14; supersedes
PJM_MEASURED_INTERNAL_TTC medians on mapped links (rule 19). DOF-ledger
measured-physical row under the flag.
